run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T01:28:32Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend traces to the ad service: the only frontend ERROR spans in the window are on GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and the client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, rising from 0 at 01:28:32 to ~1.1 spans/s per operation, while /api/cart, POST /api/checkout and the CartService/CheckoutService client spans stayed at 0. The ad service stopped serving at about 01:26:37 (its oteldemo.AdService/GetAds rate fell from a steady ~1.0/s to 0 by 01:32) because its single pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 has been crash-looping: container 'ad' terminated with exitCode 137 / reason OOMKilled (last termination 01:29:46, current state terminated 01:30:48), restartCount 4, Ready=False, 23 BackOff events 01:27:46-01:35:25, and the ad Service now has only notReadyAddresses and no ready endpoint. The memory pressure is not organic: a Chaos Mesh Schedule named otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh spawned StressChaos objects every minute from 01:26:37 to 01:34:22, each logging 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad', one minute before the first frontend error sample. The ad container's working set had climbed to ~372 MB against a 450Mi limit before the OOMKills. frontend itself is not restarting (0 restarts, Ready) and frontend-proxy's own error span rate rose in the same window, consistent with it propagating frontend 5xx, but the injection object (a Chaos Mesh custom resource) could only be seen through Kubernetes events, so the conclusion is partial.

claims.text: frontend's ERROR span rate was 0 until the sample at 2026-11-18T01:28:32Z, then rose to 0.52/s and peaked at 3.61 spans/s at 01:35:32-01:36:32 (STATUS_CODE_ERROR).

In frontend, the only operations carrying ERROR spans during 01:20-01:45 were GET, GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, each rising from 0 at 01:27:00 to about 1.06-1.12 spans/s peak; GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/cart', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/AddItem and grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder stayed at 0 over the same samples.

The ad service's own server span oteldemo.AdService/GetAds ran at a steady ~0.97-1.11 spans/s from 01:04 to 01:22, then declined from 0.94/s at 01:25:00 to 0.48/s at 01:28:00, 0.067/s at 01:30:00 and 0 from 01:32:00 onward; its internal getAdsByCategory/getRandomAds spans show the same fall to 0.

Pod otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (owned by ReplicaSet ad-554b849958) has container 'ad' not ready with restartCount 4 and state terminated exitCode 137 reason OOMKilled (finishedAt 01:30:48); lastState is also terminated exitCode 137 reason OOMKilled (startedAt 01:29:16, finishedAt 01:29:46), and the pod's Ready/ContainersReady conditions are False with reason ContainersNotReady since 01:30:49.

Kubernetes events record 23 Warning BackOff events for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 between 01:27:46 and 01:35:25 ('Back-off restarting failed container ad') and 6 Created/6 Started events for container ad on that pod between 00:50:11 and 01:32:17.

A Chaos Mesh Schedule named otel-demo-ad-memory-stress in namespace chaos-mesh generated the StressChaos objects otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-jw6mq, -7n9mk, -8b272, -sh425, -w8tqb, -w4ct8, -w98sl and -9ncrx, with 'Spawned / Create new object' events every minute from 01:26:37 through 01:34:22 and Forbid events when a previous child was still running.

StressChaos events named otel-demo-ad-memory-stress-* report 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad' at 01:26:37, 01:27:37, 01:28:37, 01:29:37, 01:30:38 and 01:33:27, each followed by TimeUp/Recovered one minute later; other instances report 'Failed to apply chaos: ... no running task found' after the container had died.

Deployment otel-demo/ad has 1 replica and container 'ad' with image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad, memory limit 450Mi and memory request 225Mi; its status exposes no readyReplicas/availableReplicas.

Container ad's container_memory_working_set_bytes on pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 rose steadily from about 332 MB at 01:03 to about 372 MB at 01:27-01:28, stayed flat at 371.9 MB through 01:30, then dropped to 183 MB, 123 MB and about 1 MB as the container restarted.

Endpoints for Service otel-demo/ad contain only notReadyAddresses for pod ad-554b849958-l9ft5 (port tcp-service 8080) and no ready address, while every other otel-demo Service listed (cart, checkout, currency, email, flagd, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) has at least one ready address.

frontend-proxy's own ERROR span rate rose from a ~0.0037-0.0074/s background level to 0.26/s at 01:28 and peaked at 2.24/s at 01:36:32 in the same window, and no error trend was seen for accounting and payment (0 across all samples), while fraud-detection and recommendation showed only the pre-existing ~0.0037/s trickle.

The frontend pod itself was healthy at query time: frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx is Running, all containers ready, restartCount 0, started 00:50:08; ad-554b849958-l9ft5 is the only otel-demo pod in the list with restarts and an unready container.

The Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress is the origin of the fault: it repeatedly injected one-minute memory-stress experiments into container otel-demo/ad-554b849958-l9ft5/ad starting 01:26:37, the ad container's memory climbed against its 450Mi limit and it was OOMKilled, the ad Service lost its only ready endpoint, and frontend's GetAds calls on GET /api/data consequently failed, producing the RequestErrorRate alert from 01:28:32. The injected fault was only observed through events, not by reading the Schedule itself.

frontend-proxy's error rise is a downstream propagation of frontend's failing /api/data responses rather than an independent failure; its own ingress/router spans were not examined after 01:18, so this remains a hypothesis.

frontend failing on its own (crash, restart or resource exhaustion) was rejected: the frontend pod has restartCount 0 and ready containers, and its error spans are confined to the /api/data path and the AdService/GetAds client span while its cart/checkout paths show 0 errors.

A flagd failure as the cause was rejected as far as it was checked: flagd-67b67fffd9-qz6gw is Running with both containers ready and 0 restarts, Service flagd has a ready endpoint, and the only ad-side ERROR spans were a single-request-level 0.0037/s blip on flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream at 01:27-01:31 rather than a sustained failure; flagd logs were not read.

Human follow-up: read the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress (namespace chaos-mesh) and its spawned StressChaos specs, stop/suspend the experiment, and consider whether the ad container's 450Mi memory limit with a memory stressor is intended for this environment; verify recovery by confirming ad-554b849958-l9ft5 becomes Ready, the ad Service endpoints gain a ready address, and frontend error spans return to the pre-01:28 baseline of 0.

gaps: The Chaos Mesh custom resources (kind Schedule and StressChaos) are not readable with the available resource kinds, so their specs (target selector, memory stressor size, duration, cron) and whether the Schedule is still active after 01:34:50 are unknown; the injection is evidenced only by Kubernetes events.
The change_history integration is not available, so who created or changed the Schedule otel-demo-ad-memory-stress and when it was changed could not be verified.

Jaeger returned no traces for the incident window: the newest frontend traces returned were 01:18:47-01:18:48, so the gRPC status/error message of the failing grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds calls and the full trace chains after 01:28 are unknown.

fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-jfvbx returned no lines for 01:25:00-01:41:30 and ad's previous container instance was unavailable, so application-level error text from frontend and the ad container's own crash output were not observed.

Prometheus samples end at about 01:41:32 (frontend error series data_as_of 01:41:00-01:41:32, container memory through 01:42:00), so behavior after 01:41:32 - including whether errors continued while the alert is still firing - is unknown, not zero.
The alerting rule RequestErrorRate was not returned by list_prometheus_rules (query result empty), so the rule expression and its exact evaluation semantics could not be verified.
kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready/available series for deployment ad returned no data, so replica readiness over time is only known from pod status and endpoints at query time.

Error-rate series were returned only for accounting, ad, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, payment and recommendation; for services not returned (cart, checkout, currency, email, image-provider, kafka, product-catalog, quote, shipping) their error rate is unknown, not zero.
